measurement_method.discovery_serialization: name + newline + description, without YAML keys or delimiters
measurement_method.network: No network; cached tokenizer data only
measurement_method.usage_scope: Captured native CLI runtime only. Author and reviewer usage is unavailable.
measurement_method.cohort_scope: Only admitted skill cores and host/admitted-skill receipt directories are measured. Excluded skill directories are pruned before receipt reads and aggregation.
measurement_method.usage_rules: Claude input/cache-write/cache-read are distinct. Codex cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not additions. ModelUsage and per-message usage are not added to CLI aggregate totals.
measurement_method.unknowns: null means unobserved or unavailable, never assumed zero
measurement_method.observed_text_scope: Prompt/final-output files and visible tool/injection text only. Hidden host context and separately supplied material were not instrumented. Text counts are not provider billing counts.
